title: 第九章 洪元帅与季军师二第十章 一试
content_zh:
这次孟国之进攻，对青山隘守军来说是凶险之极，若不是洪林英狠辣果决，用一万多军卒拖住了对方攻城时间，只怕还来不及进城部署，便已被攻下了。
此战也让城内百姓吓得亡魂皆冒，但见敌方那一副副狰狞的面容从城头上不断冒上来，近在咫尺，让他们终身难忘。
此战之后，血水铺满了城头，顺着城墙石缝向城外城内股股流下，如涓涓溪流。
城内靠近城墙半里之地，都如血池一般，平时明亮整洁的大街，那时走在上面，鞋子与血水粘在一起，发出“叭唧叭唧”之声。
洪林英事后每想到此战，即使是以他的定力，也觉得万分凶险，后背发寒。
敌军退去后，他想起季文禾昨夜所说，其中就提到对方军中可能隐藏重兵伺机待出的话，不由得心中有些后悔。
稍后几个月中，又是同样两次季文禾仍然是半夜来访，告之他敌方的动向与部署。
这两次洪林英开始重视起来，并依照季文禾给的信息，针对性的做出布置，结果他们大获全胜，损失极小。
这另外一件事便是季文禾也开也始了在军中找寻传承之人，但他的择选条件很是古怪。
既不是看其习武根骨，也不用内力探测对方身体，而是用银针对所测之人进行诊脉，如同一名郎中般。
季文禾也曾对洪林英言明，由于他们这一派内功心法甚是奇特。
如果用这法测试不能合格者，强行修炼他门派的独门心法，结果只会导致修炼之人，内气倒冲，逆经冲血而亡。
但随着时间推移，让洪林英奇怪的是，军中那么多的体格健壮之人，季文禾在进入军队一年中都未找寻到合适之人，让他惊讶不已。
随着季文禾在军事上的数次重大胜利，洪林英一年后索性让原来的军师退位当了副军师，让季文禾当了军师。
至于他每次如何得知敌方消息，他却不甚在意了，以这季军师的身手，想必手段是极多的，何况他给出数次敌方消息，都是极其准确的。
如果他是奸细，那这代价可太大了，不可能用这几次累加起来七、八万人的性命来换取后面那可能得逞的计谋。
这一举动，却让军中很多将领开始并不服气，但是接下来几次或大或小的交战，所有计划全有季文禾策划，几乎将来犯之敌杀得溃不成军。
这让季文禾一下在军中声望日益鼎盛，地位越来越稳固。
而让他声望达到顶峰的是两年半之前一次战役，那次战役之前季文禾去了城北三十里之外的中军大营，继续寻找他那不知是否存在的“徒弟”。
当地驻军有几十万之众，季文禾就是有天大的本领，一天到晚啥事也不干，以他的功力最多也就能测试个一百多人，何况军中繁忙，也不可能做到这一点。

所以他这三年多的时间除了把青山隘中几万军士测得差不多之外，开始会不时去中军大营那边寻徒。
对于季军师择徒一事，军中之人一开始觉得很稀奇，但后来大家也就慢慢习惯了。
那一次就在季文禾去了中军大营的当天下午，孟国突然发动了进攻，洪林英带兵迎敌，与敌方厮杀血战在了一起。
敌方援军这次采用了添油战术，一股股慢慢增多，铁了心不惜用人命来填，这一下把洪林英纠缠得走脱不得，慢慢陷入重围。
这时远在三十里之外的季文禾已得快马飞报，从中军大营率众赶来，待得他们来到之时，洪林英与他所率之部已岌岌可危。
季文禾让大军从外围指挥所众以八卦连环阵之势，循环向内冲杀，步步为营，而他自己则第一次在人前展露了他那可怖的武功。
一人一剑，如天外飞仙，穿梭于敌军之中，如入无人之境，除了偶尔拨开敌军袭来兵器之外，凡出一剑，必有一人毙命。
最后竟孤身一人杀到对方中军之处，凌空飞身而来，如苍鹰搏兔，在对方护卫未来得及反应之前，已踏步飞空，如流星飞矢一剑摘了对方副元帅的首级。
然后拨开身旁纷纷而至的刀枪剑戟，柔身而上，只几个踏步便站在了敌方数丈高的帅旗顶端，一手持剑，一手高举敌帅之头颅。
口中大喝，如滚滚闷雷，震荡四周，敌方一见之下军心顿时涣散，无心再战，大败而去，洪林英这才率部突围而出。
此役之后，季军师之名一时无两，甚至超过了洪元帅之名，让人们也知道了这位除了能“纸上谈兵”的军师，同样也是一位盖世高手。
此战以后，皇朝军队不再以守为主，也是经常出兵袭击对方边境，或也大军压境，此后双方互有攻守，差不多算是势均力敌。
虽有了季文禾的存在，但疆场之上，一人之力终究决定不了结果，何况孟国已知青山隘有一高手可万军之中取人首级，也亦从国内调集了数名一流和绝顶高手压阵。
洪林英通过那一次可以肯定季文禾武功已达化境之地，甚至还有可能在此境界之上，那是一个他不知道的境界。
以前他虽猜测季文禾的境界，但是也未想到对方如此厉害，做为武痴，通过那一战之后他不免的开始心中火热起来。
可是任凭他如何调查，也查不出这个门派究竟来自何方。
而通过偶尔和季文禾的切磋，他更是觉得对方武功妙到毫巅。
确切说是对方内功的精妙，任何一招普通招式，在季文禾贯注内力使来，总是让洪林英觉得犹如大江之水绵绵不绝，又如大山压顶摧枯拉朽，根本无力抗衡。
这让他对季文禾的内功心法已是欲罢不能，贪念一生，更是想方设法也要得到了。
而季文禾选徒之事却总是迟迟没有着落，而季文禾的气色如他之前所说一样，这几年越来越差，连容颜都苍老了许多。

洪林英便旁敲侧击地想让自己来继承这门绝学，于是在一次酒宴之后，他对季文禾说道。
“军师，这么多年过去了，你所择之徒却也未遇见，何种之人才能入得了你的法眼？”
季文禾微微一笑答道。
content_en:
This attack by Meng Guo was extremely dangerous for the defenders of Qingshan Pass. If Hong Linying hadn't been ruthless and decisive, using more than 10,000 soldiers to delay the enemy's attack on the city, they would have been captured before they had time to deploy into the city.
This battle also frightened the people in the city to death, but seeing the enemy's ferocious face rising up from the top of the city, so close at hand, was something they would never forget.
After this battle, blood covered the top of the city and flowed down the outside and inside of the city along the cracks in the stone walls, like a trickling stream.
The area within half a mile of the city wall was like a pool of blood. When walking on the usually bright and clean streets, the blood and blood stuck together on the streets, making a "squeaking" sound.
Whenever Hong Linying thought about this battle afterwards, even with his determination, he felt extremely dangerous and felt chills running down his back.
After the enemy army retreated, he remembered what Ji Wenhe said last night, which mentioned that there might be heavy troops hidden in the opponent's army waiting for an opportunity to come out, and he couldn't help but feel a little regretful in his heart.
In the following months, Ji Wenhe visited the same two times in the middle of the night to inform him of the enemy's movements and deployment.
These two times, Hong Linying began to pay attention and made targeted arrangements based on the information given by Ji Wenhe. As a result, they won a great victory with minimal losses.
Another thing is that Ji Wenhe also started looking for successors in the army, but his selection conditions were very strange.
Instead of looking at his martial arts roots or using internal force to detect the opponent's body, he uses a silver needle to diagnose the person's pulse, just like a doctor.
Ji Wenhe also made it clear to Hong Linying that their sect's inner strength and mentality were very unique.
If a person who fails to pass the test with this method is forced to practice his sect's unique mental method, the result will only be that the practitioner's internal energy will be reversed and his menstruation will be reversed and he will die.
But as time went by, what surprised Hong Linying was that there were so many physically strong people in the army, and Ji Wenhe was still surprised that he could not find a suitable person within a year of entering the army.
Following Ji Wenhe's several major military victories, Hong Linying simply resigned his original military advisor to become deputy military advisor a year later, and made Ji Wenhe the military advisor.
As for how he learned the enemy's news every time, he didn't care much. With the skills of this military advisor, there must be many methods, not to mention that he gave the enemy's news several times, and it was extremely accurate.
If he is a spy, then the price is too high. It is impossible to exchange the lives of 70,000 to 80,000 people in these times for the possible success of the subsequent plot.
This move made many generals in the army unconvinced at first, but in the following several battles, large or small, all plans were planned by Ji Wenhe, and almost all the invading enemies were killed and defeated.
This made Ji Wenhe's reputation in the military more and more prosperous, and his position became more and more stable.
What brought his reputation to its peak was a battle two and a half years ago. Before that battle, Ji Wenhe went to the Chinese army camp thirty miles north of the city to continue looking for his "apprentice" who did not exist.
There are hundreds of thousands of troops stationed in the local area. Ji Wenhe has great skills and does nothing all day long. With his skills, he can only test more than a hundred people at most. Not to mention the busy army, it is impossible to do this.
So in the past three years, in addition to measuring the tens of thousands of sergeants in Qingshan Pass, he would also go to the Chinese army camp from time to time to look for disciples.
The people in the army thought it was strange at first for the third army division to choose an apprentice, but then everyone gradually got used to it.
That time, on the afternoon when Ji Wenhe went to the Chinese army camp, Meng suddenly launched an attack. Hong Linying led his troops to meet the enemy and fought bloody battles with the enemy.
This time the enemy's reinforcements adopted the tactic of adding fuel, and the reinforcements gradually increased in number, determined to fill them up at the cost of human lives. This entangled Hong Linying so hard that he could not escape, and gradually fell into a tight siege.
At this time, Ji Wenhe, who was thirty miles away, had already rushed to report that he was at the Central Military Camp.He led his troops to come, but when they arrived, Hong Linying and his troops were already in danger.
Ji Wenhe asked the army to form a Bagua chain formation from the outer command post, charging inwards in a circular motion, making camp step by step, while he himself showed off his terrifying martial arts in front of people for the first time.
One person and one sword are like flying immortals from the sky, shuttling among the enemy troops, as if entering an uninhabited land. Except for occasionally deflecting the enemy's incoming weapons, every time a sword is thrown, one person will be killed.
In the end, he went to the opponent's center alone and flew in like a goshawk fighting a rabbit. Before the opponent's guards had time to react, he flew into the air and took off the opponent's deputy marshal's head with a sword like a meteor.
Then he brushed aside the swords, guns, swords and halberds that were coming to him, and stepped forward. In just a few steps, he stood on the top of the enemy's commander's flag several feet high, holding a sword in one hand and holding the enemy commander's head high in the other.
He shouted loudly in his mouth, like rolling thunder, shaking the surroundings. When the enemy saw it, their morale suddenly weakened, they had no intention of fighting anymore, and they were defeated. Only then did Hong Linying lead his troops to break out of the encirclement.
After this battle, the name of the third military advisor was unparalleled, even surpassing that of Marshal Hong. People also knew that this military advisor was not only a "paper talk" military advisor, but also an unparalleled master.
After this battle, the imperial army no longer focused on defense, and often sent troops to attack the other side's border, or to press the border with large armies. After that, the two sides attacked and defended each other, and they were almost evenly matched.
Despite Ji Wenhe's presence, on the battlefield, one person's power cannot determine the outcome. What's more, the Meng State knew that there was a master in Qingshan Pass who could kill someone among ten thousand troops, and they also mobilized several first-class and top masters from the country to hold down the battle.
Through that experience, Hong Linying could be sure that Ji Wenhe's martial arts had reached the state of transformation, and it might even be above this state. It was a state he didn't know about.
Although he had guessed at Ji Wenhe's level before, he never thought that the opponent was so powerful. As a martial arts fanatic, after that battle, he couldn't help but start to feel hot in his heart.
But no matter how he investigated, he could not find out where this sect came from.
And through occasional sparring sessions with Ji Wenhe, he even felt that the other party's martial arts skills were superb.
To be precise, it was the exquisiteness of the opponent's internal strength. Any ordinary move, when Ji Wenhe concentrated his internal strength, always made Hong Linying feel like the endless water of a river, or like a overwhelming mountain, unable to compete.
This made him obsessed with Ji Wenhe's inner strength and mental skills. He had been greedy for his whole life and tried every means to get it.
However, Ji Wenhe's selection of disciples has always been unresolved, and as he said before, Ji Wenhe's complexion has become worse and worse in recent years, and even his appearance has become much older.
Hong Linying then tried to make him inherit this unique skill, so after a banquet, he said to Ji Wenhe.
"Military advisor, so many years have passed, but you have not yet met the disciple you chose. What kind of person can enter your eyes?"
Ji Wenhe replied with a slight smile.
